## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `bfbc379fe28c87db19c2934d687b23f0a9010e59`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset). No `packages/spec/src/**` path and no governed path in the 31-file list. Inputs read: card #33229 body and all 3 comments (triage 6873327762, claim 6880383259, os-dev-report 6881826895), the PR #33372 body and file list, the net diff `9f736f2e..bfbc379f`, and the check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n`: one added pack key `common.ungroupedSection`, in all 11 shipped locales.** RIGHT. The registry and `locales/index.ts` ship en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt-BR, ru and ar. Each of the 11 locale files gains exactly one `+` line under `common`: Other, 其他, 其他, その他, 기타, Sonstiges, Autres, Otros, Outros, Прочее, أخرى. No pack line is removed or reworded, so this is a pure widening of a published catalogue.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`: `deriveFieldGroupSections(fields, fieldGroups, ungroupedLabel?)` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts:75-79`) is package-internal.** RIGHT. `package.json` `exports` has only `"."` → `dist/index`. `src/index.tsx` does not re-export `./fieldGroups`: its only `deriveFieldGroupSections` text is a doc comment at :139. It re-exports `resolveSectionGroupReferences` from `./sectionGroups` (:154), whose signature does not change. The only callers are ObjectForm, ModalForm and DrawerForm, which pass the label, and `sectionGroups.ts:117`, which passes none. That caller reads only `byKey` by `name` (:198-212), so the keyless bucket is never read there, as the new jsdoc says. The new parameter is unreachable from the entry type graph, and no public surface widens.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form` drawn output.** RIGHT. The derived trailing bucket now carries `label` (`fieldGroups.ts:95-97`, and the leftover push at :130). That holds on the ObjectForm, ModalForm and DrawerForm fallbacks, so the one row rule draws a divider row for it. Explicit and authored sections are untouched. Each arm takes `common.ungroupedSection` from its own safe translator, with an `Other` default in `formChrome.ts:84`, `ModalForm.tsx:116` and `DrawerForm.tsx:109`, and `ungroupedLabel` is in each `useMemo` dependency list.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` (`"private": true`).** RIGHT. `RecordDetailSectionLabels.ungrouped` (`recordDetailSections.ts:74-81`) is a new required field, and `UNGROUPED_SECTION_DEFAULT_LABEL` (:97) is a new export. Neither is a published accept-set. `deriveRecordDetailSections` heads the keyless bucket's primary half and gives it card chrome (`:192-197`). An all-long-form bucket returns one section from `splitPrimarySecondary`, so no empty labelled card can appear. `RecordDetailView.tsx:4098` passes `t('common.ungroupedSection','Other')`, and `t` and `language` are already in the memo dependencies.
- **Studio callers (`anchors.ts`, `PagePreview.tsx`).** RIGHT, and their output is unchanged. `deriveStudioDetailSections` returns `undefined` whenever field groups apply (`recordDetailSections.ts:235`), so `ungrouped` is never read on those paths.
- **`@object-ui/components` `form.tsx:222-225`.** RIGHT. The edit is a docblock only and changes no shipped behaviour.
- **Spec.** RIGHT. `packages/spec` is untouched, the bucket stays keyless, and no authorable key is added, so `Metadata-protocol: none` holds. The premise "the bucket exists only after at least one declared group" holds on `field-group-layout.ts:167` (no declared groups ⇒ null) and :189 (`!anyGrouped` ⇒ null).

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/33229-ungrouped-section-heading.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch and `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch. MATCHES. AGENTS.md §Before-done 3 says `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and that a non-protocol widening ships `patch`. Both packages are in the `fixed` group, so the published `@object-ui/console`, which bundles app-shell, moves with them and the record-page change ships.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is CORRECT. One catalogue key is added to a published package. Nothing is removed, renamed or tightened, and no `(narrowing)` arm applies. The changeset carries both declaration lines at line start.
- Every changeset sentence was checked against the diff and is true:
  - title (record page, record drawer, form arms);
  - Clause-② paragraph (every shipped locale; plugin-form exports unchanged; the adapter is internal);
  - spec paragraph (keyless bucket; exists only after at least one declared group);
  - Record page and drawer bullet (titled card; "More details" still split off);
  - Forms bullet (divider row on the no-sections fallback);
  - Unchanged bullet (no-groups object stays flat; authored sections untouched; spec keyless).
- nit: `@object-ui/app-shell`, the package that holds the record-page change, has no changeset entry. Precedent lists it, for example `33111-drawer-level-edit-and-scope.md`, `33098-*` and `33052-*`, and `privatePackages.version: true` gives it a CHANGELOG. Its own CHANGELOG will therefore miss this line. This does not change the level or what is published, and no gate requires it. Accepted deviation.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none in the report (`[]`). Nothing to answer.
- Deviation 1, existing pins edited (`ungroupedFieldSection-11777`, `sectionDividerProjection-9849`, `drawerFormSectionDescription-9834`): ACCEPTED. Each edit follows directly from the bucket becoming a titled section. The authored-untitled `splitAtUntitledRuns` row is unchanged, and a CONTROL keeps it headerless. The dev's ablations (record label dropped: 2 failed / 5 passed; form label dropped: 12 failed / 18 passed) are the dev's claim and were not re-run here.
- Deviation 2, comment-only `@object-ui/components` edit outside the claim's surface: ACCEPTED. The docblock now describes the authored untitled section that the path still serves. Comment-only, so no changeset is needed.
- Deviation 3, three app-shell tests touched for the required `labels.ungrouped` and the `@objectstack/lint` top import: ACCEPTED. `check:test-source-alias` asked for the import.
- Deviation 4, `content/docs/ui/*.mdx` updated beside the code: ACCEPTED, as prose-face text. nit: `field-grouping-and-order.mdx:29` says "renderers draw [the bucket] under its own **Other** heading". A Studio-seeded page for a grouped object still persists an untitled enumerated bucket (`plugin-detail` `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:745-757`), so "the Console's record page and forms" would be the exact scope.
- Deviations 5 and 6 (no local `test:repo`; app-shell type-check last ran on `6458c12e`): left to CI. Test UI 1–16/16 and Type Check UI are still running on this head (see below), so neither is green yet.
- Out-of-scope finding (carrier: none), the Studio page-create seed and slotted preview for grouped objects: ESCALATED to the seat as a follow-up card. It is not a blocker here. For a grouped object, the slotted preview (`PagePreview.tsx:321` → `undefined` → `fieldGroupSectionReferences`) now draws the bucket untitled while the running record page draws "Other". A page seeded and saved from Studio keeps the headerless bucket, which reproduces #33229's symptom on an authored page. The claim's route was renderer-only with no change to what Studio writes, so the boundary holds for this PR. The seat should file it rather than leave it with no carrier.
- nit: the `PagePreview.tsx:311-328` `useMemo` reads `t` without listing it in its dependencies. It is unreachable today, since the label is unread when groups apply, so it has no effect.
- Claim boundary held: no `packages/spec` edit and no new authorable key. The PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author-login note is needed.
- Check-runs on `bfbc379f` (61 enumerated, API `total_count` 63; 0 failed):
  - 14 success: Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset (run 43623862090), PR-body guards, Spec property liveness, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · debt ledger, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test UI shards, Plan Test Core shards, Auto Label.
  - 14 skipped, all opt-in or conditional.
  - 33 still RUNNING, NOT counted green: Test UI 1–16/16, Test Core 1–3/8, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build and E2E UI, Build Docs, Check Changeset (second run 43624131247), Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · source gates, and Lint (ESLint, PM dispatch-gates, docs and code guards, repo and tooling gates, CI release and engine gates, scoped tooling self-tests, scoped query-options erasure, scoped slot lookup and corpus).
  - Landing check ② stays open until every one of these is green.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-wj4v9l`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `d68020c3` · 2026-11-14T18:29Z

1. Shape: draft → `main`, `Fixes #33229`; 31 files, +346/−53. The root changeset patches `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/app-shell`; app-shell was added in patch 1. Two docs pages under `content/docs/ui/` change beside the code. No file lies outside `ui/packages/{app-shell,plugin-form,components,i18n}/src/`, those docs and the changeset.
2. Premise:
   - The keyless trailing bucket of `deriveFieldGroupLayout` (no `name`) now carries a heading, `common.ungroupedSection` ("Other" / 「其他」), in two places:
     - on the record page, drawer and split pane (`deriveRecordDetailSections`), where its primary half becomes a titled card and long-form fields still drop into "More details";
     - on the ObjectForm / ModalForm / DrawerForm field-group fallback (`deriveFieldGroupSections`'s new optional `ungroupedLabel`), where it gets a divider row.
   - Unchanged: authored sections, objects with no field groups (flat), and the spec, where the bucket stays keyless.
   - Changeset sentences read against the diff: each holds.
3. Contract record: PASS 6881926857 on `bfbc379f` (Clause-② yes (widening): one new pack key in all 11 locales; the new argument is package-internal). It is carried to this head by `Regen-provenance:` 6881965289 (prose-only hop: changeset frontmatter + one docs clause). `needs:contract-review` is removed.
4. Gates on head `d68020c3`: all 62 check runs are `success` or `skipped`. They include Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Test UI 16/16 shards + Test UI, Test Core 3/3 planned shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Build Docs, Check Documentation Links, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard and PR-body guards. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 33372`: NOT governed, 399 lines ≤ 3000.
5. Accepted deviations:
   - The dev's six reported deviations are accepted as the record read them:
     - three existing plugin-form pins were edited because the bucket is now titled;
     - a comment-only `@object-ui/components` docblock;
     - two PagePreview test lint fixups;
     - the local `test:repo` and app-shell type-check were left to CI (green).
   - `PagePreview.tsx:311-328` reads `t` in a `useMemo` that does not list it. That path never reads the label while field groups apply, so it has no effect today.
   - K = 44 first-parent commits since the PR base ⇒ base sync before landing; landing waits for the rerun green.
6. Out of scope: Studio's page seed and slotted preview still write the bucket untitled for an object with field groups. That is filed as #33377 (p3, `pm:queue`).
7. Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
